themes.name: Push notifications
themes.description: Notifications the app sends, including the inability to turn them off in the app settings, notification volume or content, and notification behavior such as dismissal or the notification icon.

themes.name: Playlist and queue
themes.description: Adding, saving, reordering, deleting and clearing items in the playlist or queue, including playlists that disappear after closing the app or an update, and queue playback order.

themes.name: Streaming buffering and dropouts
themes.description: Audio that buffers, stutters, skips, cuts out, or stops mid-story or mid-stream, including drops when switching networks and unreliable connections.

themes.name: Live station streaming
themes.description: Finding, connecting to and playing live streams of local or member stations, including stations that are missing, will not load, or fail to connect.

themes.name: Crashes and freezing
themes.description: The app crashing, force closing, freezing, failing to open, or not working after an app or Android update or on a specific device.

themes.name: Political bias
themes.description: Perceptions of NPR's editorial slant, fairness, balance, trustworthiness and political coverage, whether seen as biased or as unbiased and trustworthy.

themes.name: Screen orientation and tablets
themes.description: Lack of landscape or auto-rotate support and tablet layout, including the app being locked in portrait mode.

themes.name: Interface design
themes.description: Look and feel of the app, including layout, dated or modern design, Material design, menus, navigation ease, theme options, and widget design and function.

themes.name: Background running and battery
themes.description: The app starting at boot, running or restarting by itself in the background, being unable to be closed or quit, and consuming memory, battery or resources.

themes.name: Ads
themes.description: Advertising in the app, including pop-up or full-screen ads, ads that cannot be dismissed, and sponsor messages in audio.

themes.name: Chromecast and playback controls
themes.description: Requests for or complaints about Chromecast support and lockscreen or notification-bar media controls such as pause, skip and fast forward.

themes.name: Offline and SD card
themes.description: Requests for downloading audio or articles for offline listening and the ability to move the app to the SD card.

themes.name: Article text and media display
themes.description: How article content is displayed, including garbled or overlapping text, missing images, videos or tweets, font size and readability, and crashes when viewing pictures.

themes.name: Content freshness and availability
themes.description: Whether programs, stories and hourly newscasts are current and available, including outdated content, missing audio, missing episodes and past shows.

themes.name: Content quality
themes.description: Praise or opinion about NPR's programs, reporting, stories and shows as a source of news and listening, separate from app function.
